verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਟੇਵ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat gurmat sa(n)gat asaadh saadh kaasaT agan gat Tev na Tarat hai ||

en.bdb: Like wood and fire, the companies of Manmukh and Gurmukh dispense base wisdom and Guru's intelligence respectively. Wood hordes the fire within but fire destroys the wood. Both good and bad do not refrain from their nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਜਯਾ ਸਰਪ ਜਲ ਗੰਗ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਸਨ ਅਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਲਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ajayaa sarap jal ga(n)g baarunee bidhaan san aau majeeTh khal pa(n)ddit larat hai ||

en.bdb: A goat is good doer while a snake causes distress by its bite. River Ganges purifies the wine poured in it, while a drop of wine in Ganges water pollutes it. A rope of jute binds while Rubia munjista plant colours fast. Similarly fools and intelligent men are of opposite nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਟਕ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੈਲ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਸਨਾਹ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੰਸ ਕਾਗ ਬਗ ਬਿਆਧ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ka(n)Tak puhap sail ghaTikaa sanaeh sasatr ha(n)s kaag bag biaadh mirag hoi nibarat hai ||

en.bdb: A thorn pains, flowers emit fragrance. A pitcher gives cold water, a stone breaks the pitcher. An armour coat saves, weapons cause injury. A swan is of good intellect, crows and herons eat flesh. Hunters hunt dears, dears give musk and hide. All settle on who and what is good or bad.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਸੀਪ ਸੰਖ ਮਧੁ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਇਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੮॥
verses.translit_en: losaT kanik seep sa(n)kh madh kaalakooT sukh dhukh dhaik sa(n)saar bicharat hai ||298||

en.bdb: Iron made into weapons gives distress, while gold is comfort giving. A shell makes a swati drop into a pearl whereas a conch only wails. Nectar makes a person immortal while poison kills. Similarly Gurmukhs do good to all whereas Manmukhs dispense distress. (298)
